couplets.en: I fear my silence may find a voice.
I fear the secret of my love may come to light.

lines: Is qadar pyaar se na dekh mujhe
couplets.en: Do not look at me with such tenderness.

lines: Phir tamanna jawaan na ho jaye
couplets.en: I fear the old longing may stir again.
I have begun to take pleasure in your cruelty.

lines: Woh kahin mehrbaan na ho jaye
couplets.en: I fear my beloved may yet grow kind.

lines: Yeh kahin daastaan na ho jaye
couplets.en: I fear it may turn into a whole story.
I fear my silence may find a voice.
